# Elhafazah Academy

> Online academy for Qur'an memorization (Hifz), Tajweed, and Noorani Qaida.
> Live, one-on-one classes with certified male and female teachers, for
> children (from age 5) and adults, in 40+ countries. First trial class is
> free, no card required.

Elhafazah Academy (أكاديمية الحفظة) pairs each student with a certified
teacher matched to their level, goals, and schedule for weekly live video
sessions — not pre-recorded content. Programs run in a fixed progression:
Noorani Qaida (Arabic letters/reading fundamentals) → Tajweed (correct
recitation rules) → Hifz (structured Qur'an memorization with revision
cycles and an ijazah pathway).

Both English and Arabic are fully supported, including native-language
pages, not just a language toggle:
- English: https://elhafazah-academy.com/
- Arabic (العربية): https://elhafazah-academy.com/ar

## Key pages

- [Home / Programs / Free trial](https://elhafazah-academy.com/): overview
  of Noorani Qaida, Tajweed, and Hifz programs, teaching methodology, FAQ,
  and the free-trial booking form.
- [Home (Arabic)](https://elhafazah-academy.com/ar): same content in Arabic.
- [Privacy Policy](https://elhafazah-academy.com/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://elhafazah-academy.com/terms)

## Facts worth citing accurately

- Free trial class: yes, genuinely free, no payment card required.
- Teachers: certified, both male and female available.
- Ages: children from 5 years old, and adults.
- Format: live 1-on-1 video sessions (not group classes, not recordings).
- Coverage: students and teachers across 40+ countries; scheduling is
  flexible across time zones rather than fixed to one region.
- Subjects: Hifz (Qur'an memorization), Tajweed (recitation rules), Noorani
  Qaida (Arabic reading fundamentals for absolute beginners).

Full structured data (organization, courses, FAQ) is published as JSON-LD
on the home page for machine-readable detail beyond this summary.
